name: Introduction to Business
description: Introduces key business concepts, business environments, and organisational functions.

name: Principles of Accounting
description: Covers basic financial accounting concepts, transaction recording, and financial statements.

name: Business Communication
description: Develops written, verbal, and presentation skills for professional business settings.

name: Principles of Management
description: Introduces management principles, leadership, planning, and organisational structure.

name: Microeconomics
description: Examines consumer behaviour, firms, market structures, and resource allocation.

name: Marketing Fundamentals
description: Introduces marketing principles, customer behaviour, segmentation, and the marketing mix.

name: Business Statistics
description: Covers descriptive statistics, probability, data analysis, and business decision-making.

name: Business Information Systems
description: Explores how information systems support business operations and management.

name: Corporate Finance
description: Introduces financial management, investment decisions, and sources of business finance.

name: Macroeconomics
description: Examines national economies, inflation, unemployment, economic growth, and fiscal policy.

name: Human Resource Management
description: Covers recruitment, training, performance management, and employee relations.

name: Operations Management
description: Explores process design, quality management, capacity planning, and operations strategy.

name: Business Law
description: Introduces legal principles relevant to contracts, business organisations, and commercial activities.

name: Consumer Behaviour
description: Examines psychological and social factors that influence consumer purchasing decisions.

name: Management Accounting
description: Covers costing, budgeting, and the use of accounting information for management decisions.

name: Business Research Methods
description: Introduces research design, data collection, analysis, and business report writing.

name: Strategic Management
description: Examines strategy formulation, competitive analysis, and implementation in organisations.

name: Entrepreneurship
description: Explores opportunity identification, business model development, and venture planning.

name: International Business
description: Studies global business environments, international trade, and cross-cultural management.

name: Business Analytics
description: Introduces the use of business data and analytical methods to support decisions.

name: Business Ethics and Sustainability
description: Examines ethical decision-making, corporate responsibility, and sustainable business practices.

name: Project Management
description: Covers project planning, scheduling, risk management, and project execution.

name: Digital Business
description: Explores digital platforms, e-commerce, and technology-driven business models.

name: Business Capstone Project
description: Integrates business knowledge through an applied project addressing a practical business issue.
